svg.title: How SLMJury works
svg.desc: Four steps. Benchmarks: 8 with a reference answer (math, science, general) and 2 open-ended (SummEval, MT-Bench). Judges: 16 small (0.6B–14B) and 6 large (70B–122B), with the same prompts, students and oracle. Settings: every judge alone; small judges also with 6 adversarial personas, majority voting in juries of 3 and multi-agent debate; at B = 10 (a one-word verdict) and B = 8,192 (reasoning first). Scoring: verdicts against a programmatic oracle give accuracy; 1–5 scores against human or model scores give Spearman's ρ.
